basic_workshop.description: The first production unit established. Basic tools and spare parts are produced here. Insufficient for complex systems.

assembly_workshop.description: A mid-level workshop that assembles mechanical parts. The production point for protective equipment and life support modules.

electronics_workshop.description: A precision environment where circuit boards, energy systems, and sensors are produced. Dust and humidity control are mandatory.

press_machine.description: Shapes metal with high pressure. Titanium plates and structural components are produced on this machine.

construction_workshop.description: The center for base expansion and structural construction operations. New cells and infrastructure modules are managed from here.

chemistry_table.description: A controlled environment where chemical compounds are synthesized. Water treatment, fertilizer production, and atmosphere systems are prepared here.

ore_processing_furnace.description: Converts raw minerals into processed and usable forms. Contains an armored cabin for the safe processing of dangerous elements like uranium and lithium.

advanced_workshop.description: The most advanced production unit in the colony. Nuclear reactors, exploration vehicles, and autonomous systems can only be produced here. Installation can take months.
